Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)

Required findings: Presence of traumatic spinal fracture or dislocation with documented instability or anticipated iatrogenic instability after decompression
Presence of infection (discitis, epidural abscess, osteomyelitis) with documented instability or anticipated iatrogenic instability after debridement/decompression
Primary or metastatic neoplastic disease causing pathologic fracture, cord compression, or instability, or anticipated iatrogenic instability after resection/decompression
Severe debilitating pain or functional dysfunction to the point of incapacitation, documented in the clinical record, with concordant imaging findings

Non-Indications: Elective lumbar fusion without meeting any urgent/emergent criteria and without documented trial of required conservative therapy
Failure to complete the required non‑surgical management (e.g., physical therapy, pain management) before surgery
Current smoking status without documented cessation when smoking cessation is required for non‑urgent cases
Unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorders (major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid or alcohol use disorder) when not an urgent/emergent indication
Repeat lumbar fusion performed within the prohibited time interval as defined in CMM‑600.1
Absence of imaging evidence of instability, fracture, infection, or neoplastic involvement when such findings are required for the indication
Important criteria & exceptions: Determination of medical necessity is made on a case‑by‑case basis
Urgent/emergent indications waive requirements for documented non‑surgical management, smoking cessation, and mental health stability
Timing and additional documentation requirements are detailed in CMM‑600.1: Prior Authorization Requirements
Imaging findings noted in the applicable procedure section must be present to support the indication
Documentation required: MRI and/or CT of the lumbar spine demonstrating instability, fracture, infection, or neoplastic involvement
Dynamic flexion/extension radiographs confirming segmental instability when applicable
Clinical notes documenting severe debilitating pain, functional impairment, and incapacity
Records of completed conservative therapy (physical therapy, pain management) including duration and outcomes
Smoking cessation documentation or statement of current smoking status
Mental health assessment confirming stability or documentation of treatment for relevant disorders
Prior operative reports and dates if this is a repeat fusion to verify interval compliance
Laboratory results (elevated WBC, CRP, ESR) supporting infection when infection is the indication
